mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalHits, COALESCE(SUM(shadow), 0) AS shadowHits, COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS involvedApplications, COUNT(DISTINCT rule_code) AS distinctRules FROM risk_rule_hit_log

SELECT rule_code AS ruleCode, rule_name AS ruleName, layer AS layer, action AS action, COUNT(*) AS hitCount, COALESCE(SUM(shadow), 0) AS shadowHits, COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS applicationCount FROM risk_rule_hit_log GROUP BY rule_code, rule_name, layer, action ORDER BY hitCount DESC
SELECT layer AS layer, action AS action, COUNT(*) AS hitCount FROM risk_rule_hit_log GROUP BY layer, action ORDER BY layer, action

SELECT h.rule_code AS ruleCode, h.rule_name AS ruleName, COUNT(DISTINCT h.application_id) AS applicationCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.application_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approvedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.application_status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejectedCount FROM risk_rule_hit_log h LEFT JOIN loan_application a ON a.application_id = h.application_id WHERE h.shadow = 0 GROUP BY h.rule_code, h.rule_name ORDER BY applicationCount DESC

SELECT id, application_id AS applicationId, user_id AS userId, rule_id AS ruleId, rule_code AS ruleCode, rule_name AS ruleName, layer, action, shadow, hit_time AS hitTime FROM risk_rule_hit_log ORDER BY hit_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, application_id AS applicationId, user_id AS userId, rule_id AS ruleId, rule_code AS ruleCode, rule_name AS ruleName, layer, action, shadow, hit_time AS hitTime FROM risk_rule_hit_log WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY hit_time
